text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for next quarter's console/observability slice: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. Customer-driven asks piling up, goal is an acceptance checklist by Fri. Propose canary rollout + 1-month SLA. Thoughts?

Lee: For dashboards I can deliver baseline widgets (P95 latency, token throughput, cost per-route trend) in 2 sprints if we reuse the existing templates.

Sam: Tracing hooks need sample-rate controls + ability to tag by route/customer. Without route-level sampling overrides, oncall will be swamped. Propose default sample=0.1, with per-route override.

Jen: Error analytics should include grouping (stack-hash), simple root-cause tags, and a link-to-runbook in the alert. Otherwise SRE time to triage is high.

Arjun: UX note — make dashboard templates composable (tile + filter model). Avoid custom chart editors in MVP.

Maya: Prioritization vote: MUST = baseline dashboards, trace sampling control, cost-per-route history, error grouping + basic alerts. NICE = auto-threshold suggestions, flamegraphs, per-customer cost allocation. Missing anything critical?

Lee: One more metric request from infra: KV cache hit/miss for model servers — helps evaluate batching/caching wins. Can we add it to MUST for ops visibility?

Sam: SLA / launch criteria proposal: 90th percentile dashboard render < 1s for most views, seeded alerts must trigger on 3 simulated faults, telemetry coverage >= 80% for top-10 routes.

Maya: Good. @infra-bot can you start a coverage measurement job for the top 10?

infra-bot: measurement job started — run_id=obs-prio-1768456789, target=top10_routes, expected_ttl=2h. Will post results to thread when done.

Olivia: Customer note: BigRetail asked specifically for per-project cost breakdown + CSV export. That makes per-customer cost allocation higher priority for enterprise track.

Maya: OK — mark per-customer export as "enterprise-gated MUST" and put it on the Dedicated/Private timeline.

Lee: Dependency: backend schema change to include `billing_tag` and `route_owner`. I'll open a PR tomorrow. Example: `ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN billing_tag TEXT;`

Sam: Flag: retention policy for traces. Suggest default 30d for hosted, 90d for enterprise. We'll need storage sizing before enabling 90d.

Maya: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc with these acceptance criteria and deps, and add an explicit canary checklist row. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Jen: I'll draft the alert taxonomy and example runbook snippets this afternoon.

Arjun: I'll mock the composable tile patterns and share in Figma by EOD.

Maya: Great — if anyone has blockers, add them here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
